heading: EXT. HOLLOW BELL TOWER, DROWNED CITY - TWILIGHT

units.text: EXT. HOLLOW BELL TOWER, DROWNED CITY - TWILIGHT
Moss on the stairs.
Water laps the third floor.
A bronze bell the size of a cart hangs cracked, humming faintly.
QUEEN SABLE VANTHA (40s, armor of woven eel-leather) stands alone beside it, lantern at her feet.
She touches the bell with a gloved hand.
It hums louder.
Count the stairs. Tell me when I'm lying.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: Nobody answers.
Water laps.
She draws her sword.
I drowned your city. Say it to my face.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: The bell hums higher.
Behind her, boots on the stairs.
She spins, blade level.
Her squire DOBRINA WICK (20s, soaked, nervous) hauls herself up with a coil of rope.
Sable lowers the sword an inch.
Majesty. You said wait below.
units.name: DOBRINA

units.text: I said wait. You never listen.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: The water is rising, Majesty. Fast.
units.name: DOBRINA

units.text: I know. Get behind me.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: Dobrina drops the rope; it uncoils over the edge and plunges.
Sable lifts the lantern while Dobrina grabs her sleeve, and the flame bends sideways as the humming swells.
It's singing at us.
units.name: DOBRINA

units.text: It sings when it's afraid.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: Bells aren't afraid, Majesty.
units.name: DOBRINA

units.text: This one drowned a city. Be afraid for it.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: A crack runs up the bell's flank with a sound like a shot.
Sable steps forward, and Dobrina, after one terrified breath, steps with her, and together they lay both hands on the bronze.
Whatever it asks, don't answer.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: What will it ask?
units.name: DOBRINA

units.text: Your name. Mine, it already has.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: The bronze goes silent.
The water stops.
Then, from inside the bell, very softly, a child's voice begins to count.
